cost.note: not available; all cost numbers in the deliverable are PLANNING cost units, not money

headline_planning_numbers.note: all values are planning arithmetic (physical anchors + planning cost coefficients), NOT measured money and NOT acquisition effect

notes: no acquisition experiment, no training, no replay and no simulated returns were run in this round; the deliverables are design + cost model + prior art + protocol draft only

cost is expressed in planning cost units (well-equivalents) with optimistic/central/conservative scenarios; coefficients must be replaced by quotes/LOIs before any freeze (the project has no certified monetary cost record)

cell-line setup (seeding optimisation 1,344 wells + day=1 plate 1,536 wells per cell) dominates a 125-cell C136-scale campaign; the charged-vs-sunk accounting rule must be frozen before comparing strategies with different cell breadth
equal-cost verification is defined on total cost units with packing/batch rules and a three-scenario robustness check; equal rows/wells/keys are explicitly forbidden as equal-cost proxies

statistical power (n_eff / MDE / delta_min) is kept separate from cost: C136 (1,600 keys -> 80% power; 200 -> 0.46), C144 (allocation nearly neutral), C154/R187 (saturation), C171 (n_eff ~189 from 96 cells)
menu-near-oracle gate: R2's 5-cell menu had residual regret 0.004343 vs KG-random CI width ~0.145, so that menu cannot test acquisition; each candidate menu must pre-check headroom vs MDE

prior art: components (decision-focused BOED, BATCHIE plate selection, GP-KG, EVSI/ENBS, cost/fidelity-aware acquisition) are covered; no direct precedent found for the fully-costed equal-budget comparison with a menu-oracle gate; NO novelty claim is made (consistent with R189 line B)
